metrics.market_cap_basis: 2025-05-26 signal close HK$0.660000026 and 415,000,000 shares; CNY amount converted back to HKD using input HKD/CNY rate.

cash_breakdown.item: Unrestricted cash and bank balances excluding disclosed PRC cash and pledged cash
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Cash appears mainly in Hong Kong operating group rather than proven listed-parent excess cash; use ordinary operating subsidiary cash haircut.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 24 disclosed total cash HK$128.054m, of which HK$1.529m was in PRC and HK$2.393m was pledged.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: PRC cash is subject to exchange restrictions and no fast dividend path was disclosed.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 24 disclosed HK$1.529m cash placed with banks or on hand in PRC.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Pledged for banking facilities; not treated as detachable while related facilities exist.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 24 and note 28 disclosed HK$2.393m cash pledged for banking facilities.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Deposits pledged to secure bank borrowings.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 23 disclosed pledged bank deposits HK$7.338m.

cash_breakdown.item: Financial assets at FVTPL - life insurance policies
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Life insurance policies for key management have no quoted market price and are linked to personnel arrangements; not treated as detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 17 disclosed surrender-value life insurance policies for key management.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Interest-bearing bank debt is deducted at 100%.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 28 disclosed secured bank borrowings HK$80.810m, current or repayable on demand.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Retained to support payroll-heavy service operations, receivable collection lag and large public-sector contracts.
cash_breakdown.reason: Cash operating cost is high relative to cash balance; 2024 revenue was HK$2.603bn, accrued wages and benefits were HK$228.573m and trade receivables were HK$554.451m.

cash_breakdown.item: Tax, FX and dividend friction reserve
cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Small reserve for extracting subsidiary cash and PRC remittance friction.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report does not disclose exact legally distributable cash by entity.

cash_breakdown.haircut_reason: Operating leases are continuing-business obligations and are reflected through profit and cash conversion instead of mechanically deducting from detachable cash.
cash_breakdown.reason: Annual report note 29 disclosed lease liabilities HK$38.088m.

profit_quality.assessment: Use HK$50.0m as pre-haircut distributable cash profit, below the 2022-2024 median parent net profit of HK$53.709m, after considering small non-recurring gains and government grants. Apply a 0.75 cash profit haircut because three-year free cash flow after capex is volatile: 2022 was negative after heavy capex, 2023 was close to profit, and 2024 was very strong but helped by receivable reduction and higher accrued payroll/benefit liabilities.
adjustments: Do not use 2024 free cash flow HK$227.459m as recurring profit because it included HK$44.482m trade receivable reduction and HK$85.008m increase in accruals and other payables.
Treat 2024 gain on disposal of right-of-use assets HK$2.491m, government grants HK$1.545m and interest income HK$1.878m as non-core or lower-quality contributors.
Use ordinary service-company continuing operations; no financial, insurance, bank, securities, property development or investment holding formula override was applied.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: 2022-2024 parent net profit was HK$53.709m, HK$47.111m and HK$53.856m. Operating cash flow less PPE purchases was -HK$44.846m, HK$52.693m and HK$227.459m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Receivable-heavy payroll service model and volatile reinvestment/cash conversion justify a 0.75 factor rather than using reported net profit one-for-one.
profit_quality.cash_conversion_assessment: Three-year median free cash flow after capex is about HK$52.693m, but the range is wide.
profit_quality.maintenance_capex_assessment: Maintenance capex is not separately disclosed; latest PPE purchase HK$34.982m and three-year capex history were used as checks.
profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: Trade receivables HK$554.451m remain large and HK$132.923m were pledged; collection improvement in 2024 may not repeat every year.
